name: Kiboar
description: Keyboard components for KiCad: switches, keycaps, controller boards, connectors, displays and more.
description_full:
Kiboar is a keyboard-component library for KiCad 10: 146 symbols, 1329 footprints and 144 3D models, split into 23 footprint libraries.

The bulk of the content is original work under the MIT licence. 133 models and 131 of the 146 symbols are original, and carry the author and the licence inside the file: the STEP FILE_NAME header and two hidden symbol properties. The other eleven models are from the Keyswitch KiCad Library and are used under its MIT option. Fifteen symbols are third-party imports that keep their own licence: ten from SnapEDA and five from Component Search Engine, both CC BY-SA 4.0 with the Design Exception, so they need attribution when the files themselves are redistributed. No model or footprint carries a non-commercial or NoDerivatives licence. See the NOTICE file in the source repository for the per-origin list, the evidence and the required attribution before you redistribute the collection.
